title: Metric units & scientific notation
sentences: A unit tells us what a number measures.
Length uses meters, area uses square meters, and volume uses cubic meters.
Mass uses kilograms; liters describe capacity.
Scientific notation preserves a number's value while moving its decimal point: the power of ten tells you how far it moved.
Move the decimal four places right to get 7.2.
Because the original number is less than 1, use a negative exponent: 10⁻⁴.
Multiplying back gives the original measurement.
